nn3_audit_board.source: Computed from the supplied training files and the test input files (shape, Depth, keys and feature vectors only); no test labels are read.

nn3_calibration.source: Computed: logistic-regression baselines. Left, esp_train.csv with leave-one-entity-out predictions (3,243 rows); right, Sensor_train.csv with the reference stratified 20% validation split (716 rows). Bins with fewer than 10 rows are omitted.

nn3_class_weights.source: Computed from esp_train.csv: logistic regression with and without class_weight='balanced', leave-one-entity-out predictions pooled over seven entities.

nn3_confusion.source: Computed from esp_train.csv: logistic-regression baseline, leave-one-entity-out predictions pooled over the seven entities, threshold 0.5.

nn3_data_roles.source: Schematic of the three roles for data in the capstone: fit on the training portion, select on the validation portion, assess once on the supplied test file.

nn3_day_gantt.source: Schematic day plan matching the agenda: 165 min of lectures including the close, 170 min of project sprints, four 10-min checkpoints, 35 min of presentations, 70 min of breaks.

nn3_depth_errors.source: Computed from Log curve - Train.csv: absolute errors of the Ridge baseline and of the training-mean prediction on the validation block, grouped in 25-unit Depth blocks with at least five rows.

nn3_early_stop.source: Computed: the reference workflow in curriculum/capstone.py on the ESP project (width 32, AdamW lr 0.001, seed 42, patience 8), validation = held-out entities esp_30 and esp_31.

nn3_entity_errors.source: Computed from esp_train.csv: logistic-regression baseline, leave-one-entity-out; each entity scored by a model fitted on the other six. Labels give errors/rows of that class.

nn3_esp_class_dist.source: Computed from esp_train.csv: 3,193 rows with all six sensors present, pooled over seven entities; step histograms normalized within each class.

nn3_esp_split.source: Computed split membership: GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=2, random_state=42) on ENTITY as in curriculum/capstone.py, and LeaveOneGroupOut folds; test entity names from esp_test.csv.

nn3_esp_timeline.source: Computed from esp_train.csv (labels, missing cells, timestamps) and from the ENTITY and TimeSlot columns of esp_test.csv; the test label file is not read.

nn3_esp_traces.source: Computed from esp_train.csv: entities esp_30 and esp_39, rows sorted by TimeSlot; values as supplied (units undocumented); shading marks GAS_LOCK = 1 and rows whose six sensors are all missing.

nn3_evidence.source: Computed from esp_train.csv. Left: scikit-learn MLP (32 units), random 5-fold row split, pooled accuracy (a deliberately weak evidence figure). Right: leave-one-entity-out average precision per entity for logistic regression and the same MLP with identical preprocessing.

nn3_ladder.source: Computed on the PE reference split (source rows 0-2336 train, 2337-2921 validation): scikit-learn baselines and the reference training loop from curriculum/capstone.py.

nn3_lifecycle.source: Schematic of the capstone project lifecycle and the four milestone checkpoints.

nn3_log_corr.source: Computed from Log curve - Train.csv: Pearson correlations over all 2,922 training rows (descriptive; rows are not independent). ILD = ILD_log10.

nn3_log_pe_dist.source: Computed from Log curve - Train.csv: PE in the training portion and in the validation block of the reference split (last 20% of source rows).

nn3_log_split.source: Computed from Log curve - Train.csv: Depth in source-row order; the reference split keeps rows 0-2336 for training and holds out rows 2337-2921.

nn3_log_tracks.source: Computed from Log curve - Train.csv: source rows 0-470, the first block of increasing Depth; curves as supplied, units undocumented; well identity is not given.

nn3_model_card.source: Template with values computed from esp_train.csv (logistic baseline, leave-one-entity-out average precision per entity).

nn3_param_count.source: Exact parameter counts for dense networks with 6 inputs and one output (weights plus biases); training-row counts from the reference splits in curriculum/capstone.py.

nn3_positional.source: Schematic with illustrative GR values: positional labels paired with predictions made after re-ordering the inputs.

nn3_preprocess.source: Schematic of the preprocessing order; value ranges computed from the training portion (five entities) of the reference ESP split in esp_train.csv.

nn3_presentation.source: Schematic storyboard for the five-minute team presentation.

nn3_repro.source: Schematic of a reproducible capstone run; command-line options and artifact names from curriculum/capstone.py.

nn3_residuals.source: Computed from Log curve - Train.csv: Ridge baseline fitted on source rows 0-2336, residuals on the validation block (rows 2337-2921).

nn3_seed_spread.source: Computed: the reference training loop from curriculum/capstone.py on the PE project, seeds 0-4 per width (bars = medians), same split and preprocessing; baselines fitted on the same training portion.

nn3_sensor_class_dist.source: Computed from Sensor_train.csv (3,580 rows): histogram of col1 by class, and per-column medians with interquartile ranges; column index is a name, not a verified time axis.

nn3_sensor_corr.source: Computed from Sensor_train.csv: Pearson correlations between col1-col10 over 3,580 rows; the minimum off-diagonal value is 0.9995.

nn3_sensor_uuid.source: Computed from Sensor_train.csv: row means in uuid order; macro-F1 from StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed 0) versus GroupKFold(5) on five contiguous uuid blocks, scaling fitted inside folds, threshold 0.5.

nn3_shared_pipeline.source: Schematic of a matched comparison: one split, one fitted preprocessing, two models, one evaluation.

nn3_split_gap.source: Computed from esp_train.csv (3,243 rows, 7 entities): scikit-learn models with median imputation and scaling fitted inside each fold; KFold(5, shuffle, seed 0) versus LeaveOneGroupOut on ENTITY; pooled out-of-fold accuracy at threshold 0.5.

nn3_three_projects.source: Computed on the reference splits of curriculum/capstone.py (training files only): reference = prevalence, training mean or majority class; linear = logistic or Ridge; trees = HistGradientBoosting (defaults); network = reference training loop, width 32, seed 42. Sensor thresholds chosen on validation.

nn3_tree_bias.source: Synthetic example, seed 0: 300 noisy samples of a step function; scikit-learn HistGradientBoostingRegressor and MLPRegressor (64, 64) with default settings; RMSE against the true function on a fine grid.
